# 🎨 Chroma-Anime-AIO 简单工作流程

我的 Chroma-Anime-AIO 超级简单的即插即用工作流程非常有效！非常适合初学者和任何想要快速入门而不复杂的人。

不需要额外的节点。无需加载 VAE。无需配置 CLIP。只需加载检查点并开始创建！

我希望您发现它在任何方面都很有用。玩得开心！ 🚀

---

## 📦 包含内容：

✅ 仅标准 ComfyUI 节点 - 无需自定义节点！

✅ 有用的注释节点，包含提示和设置指南

✅ 预配置设置（16步，CFG 4.2，1024×1024）

✅ 帮助您入门的示例提示

✅ 分辨率预设和调整技巧

---

## 🔧 此工作流程中使用的资源：

检查点：[Chroma-动漫-AIO](https://civitai.com/models/2022057)

---

---

## 💡 快速入门：

1.下载并放置Chroma-Anime-AIO.safetensors在ComfyUI/模型/检查点/

2. 在 ComfyUI 中加载此工作流程

3. 输入提示（提示：以“anime”开头，动漫风格更强烈！）

4. 点击“队列提示”

5. 完成！ ✨

---

## ⚙️ 推荐设置：

快速/测试：

- 步数：16

CFG：3.6

- 分辨率：512×512或1024×1024

平衡的质量：

- 步骤：16-20

- CFG：4.2

- 分辨率：1024×1024

高细节：

- 步骤：22-26

- CFG：4.2-5.0

- 分辨率：1024×1024或更高

---

## 📝 提示提示：

✅ 在开头添加“动漫”，以获得更强的动漫美感

✅ 自然语言效果很好：“春天花园里的银发女孩”

✅ 标签也有效：“1girl，银色头发，绿色眼睛，微笑”

✅ 混合两者：“动漫，1 女孩，有着飘逸的银色头发，细致的祖母绿眼睛，樱花”

---

## 🎮 测试环境：RTX 4060 Ti (8GB VRAM)

所有高达 2K 的分辨率均可流畅运行！也应该适用于 6GB+ VRAM 卡。

---

享受创作的乐趣！ 🎨

# 🎨 Chroma-Anime-AIO Simple Workflow

My super simple plug-and-play workflow for Chroma-Anime-AIO that just works! Perfect for beginners and anyone who wants to get started quickly without complexity.

No extra nodes needed. No VAE to load. No CLIP to configure. Just load the checkpoint and start creating!

I hope you find it useful in any way. Have fun! 🚀

---

## 📦 What's Included:

✅ Standard ComfyUI nodes only - no custom nodes required!

✅ Helpful note nodes with tips and settings guides

✅ Pre-configured settings (16 steps, CFG 4.2, 1024×1024)

✅ Example prompts to get you started

✅ Resolution presets and tweaking tips

---

## 🔧 Resources used in this workflow:

Checkpoint:[Chroma-Anime-AIO](https://civitai.com/models/2022057)

---

---

## 💡 Quick Start:

1. Download and placeChroma-Anime-AIO.safetensorsinComfyUI/models/checkpoints/

2. Load this workflow in ComfyUI

3. Enter your prompt (tip: start with "anime," for stronger anime style!)

4. Click "Queue Prompt"

5. Done! ✨

---

## ⚙️ Recommended Settings:

Fast/Test:

- Steps: 16

- CFG: 3.6

- Resolution: 512×512 or 1024×1024

Balanced Quality:

- Steps: 16-20

- CFG: 4.2

- Resolution: 1024×1024

High Detail:

- Steps: 22-26

- CFG: 4.2-5.0

- Resolution: 1024×1024 or higher

---

## 📝 Prompting Tips:

✅ Add "anime," at the start for stronger anime aesthetic

✅ Natural language works great: "a girl with silver hair in a spring garden"

✅ Tags work too: "1girl, silver hair, green eyes, smile"

✅ Mix both: "anime, 1girl with flowing silver hair, detailed emerald eyes, cherry blossoms"

---

## 🎮 Tested on: RTX 4060 Ti (8GB VRAM)

All resolutions up to 2K work smoothly! Should also work on 6GB+ VRAM cards.

---

Enjoy creating! 🎨
